Q116142348.blurb: Supporters of former Brazil president Jair Bolsonaro storm the Brazilian Congress.

Q116179414.name: Battle of the Eureka Stockade
Q116179414.blurb: Battle of the Eureka Stockade: More than 20 gold miners at Ballarat, Victoria, are killed by state troopers in an uprising over mining licences.

Q116205343.name: Yeti Airlines Flight 691
Q116205343.blurb: Yeti Airlines Flight 691 crashes near Pokhara International Airport, killing all 72 people on board.

Q116205593.name: 1987 Forsyth County protests
Q116205593.blurb: About 20,000 protestors march in a civil rights demonstration in Forsyth County, Georgia, United States.

Q116233469.name: 1912 Little Falls textile strike
Q116233469.blurb: Following a reduction in pay, textile workers in Little Falls, New York, walked out of their mill, starting a three-month strike.

Q116246018.name: 2023 Brovary helicopter crash
Q116246018.blurb: A helicopter crash in Ukraine leaves 14 people dead, including the country's Interior Minister, Denys Monastyrsky.

Q116252514.name: Battle of Chios
aliases: Capture of Chios (1912), Liberation of Chios
Q116252514.blurb: First Balkan War: Greece completes its capture of the eastern Aegean island of Chios, as the last Ottoman forces on the island surrender.

Q116265820.name: Bolshevik–Makhnovist conflict
Q116265820.blurb: Bolshevik–Makhnovist conflict: Mikhail Frunze declares victory over the Makhnovshchina.

Q116291297.name: 2023 Monterey Park shooting
Q116291297.blurb: Huu Can Tran, 72, opens fire in a dance studio in Monterey Park, California, killing eleven people and injuring nine others before later committing suicide. It is the worst mass shooting in Los Angeles County since the 2008 Covina massacre.

Q116413522.name: Death of Arshad Sharif
Q116413522.blurb: Pakistani journalist Arshad Sharif is shot and killed by local police in Kajiado, Kenya.

Q116447988.name: killing of Tyre Nichols
Q116447988.blurb: Protests and public outrage spark across the U.S. after the release of multiple videos by the Memphis Police Department showing officers punching, kicking, and pepper spraying Tyre Nichols as a result of running away from a traffic stop, which resulted him dying in the hospital three days later after the incident.

Q116449092.name: Attack on the embassy of Azerbaijan in Iran
aliases: Armed Attack on the Embassy of Azerbaijan in Tehran (2023)
Attack on the Azerbaijani embassy in Tehran
Q116449092.blurb: An attack on the Azerbaijani embassy in Pasdaran, Tehran, kills one person and injures three others.

Q116455185.name: 2023 Jerusalem synagogue shooting
Q116455185.blurb: A shooting at a synagogue in Neve Yaakov, East Jerusalem, kills seven people and injures three others.

Q116456768.name: Tyre Nichols protests
Q116456768.blurb: Protests and public outrage spark across the U.S. after the release of multiple videos by the Memphis Police Department showing officers punching, kicking, and pepper spraying Tyre Nichols as a result of running away from a traffic stop, which resulted him dying in the hospital three days later after the incident.

Q116675957.name: 1834 Philadelphia race riot
Q116675957.blurb: A race riot in Philadelphia destroyed African-American businesses and killed two people.

Q116691303.name: 2023 Turkey–Syria earthquakes
Q116691303.blurb: Two earthquakes measuring Mww 7.8 and 7.5 struck near the border between Turkey and Syria with a maximum Mercalli intensity of XII (Extreme). The earthquakes resulted in numerous aftershocks and a death toll of 57,658 people.

Q116730692.name: Coronation of Mary I of England
Q116730692.blurb: The coronation of Queen Mary I of England is held at Westminster Abbey.

Q116753653.name: 2023 Ohio train derailment
Q116753653.blurb: Ohio train derailment: A freight train containing vinyl chloride and other hazardous materials derails and burns in East Palestine, Ohio, United States, releasing hydrogen chloride and phosgene into the air and contaminating the Ohio River.

Q116763949.name: 1764 Woldegk tornado
Q116763949.blurb: One of the strongest tornadoes in history strikes Woldegk, Germany, killing one person while leveling numerous mansions with winds estimated greater than 300 miles per hour (480 km/h).

Q116908318.name: Coronation of George III and Charlotte
Q116908318.blurb: George III and Charlotte of Mecklenburg-Strelitz are crowned King and Queen, respectively, of the Kingdom of Great Britain.

Q116946502.name: Tempi train crash
Q116946502.blurb: Two trains collide south of the Vale of Tempe in Greece, leading to the deaths of at least 57 people and leaving 58 missing and 85 injured.

Q116958167.name: Hlaingthaya massacre
Q116958167.blurb: Burmese security forces kill at least 65 civilians in the Hlaingthaya massacre.

Q116987070.name: Jasper Abraham murder case
Q116987070.blurb: Kitosh, an African labourer, died after having been flogged by his British employer, in a case that eventually led to reform of the legal system of the Kenya Colony.

Q117019364.name: Bapaume town hall explosion
Q117019364.blurb: World War I: A delayed action bomb left by German troops exploded in the town hall of Bapaume, France, killing 24 soldiers and civilians.

Q117021134.name: 1916–1917 northern Minnesota lumber strike
Q117021134.blurb: Up to 1,000 lumber workers initiated a labor strike against the Virginia and Rainy Lake Lumber Company in Minnesota, United States, which lasted over a month.

Q117038068.name: Hamburg shooting
Q117038068.blurb: A shooting in the Alsterdorf quarter of Hamburg, Germany, kills eight people and injures another eight.

Q117040500.name: 2023 Belgrade City Assembly election
Q117040500.blurb: A series of mass protests began in Belgrade, Serbia, alleging electoral irregularities in the Serbian parliament and Belgrade city assembly elections.

Q117053334.name: collapse of Silicon Valley Bank
Q117053334.blurb: Silicon Valley Bank collapses due to a run on its deposits, in the second largest bank failure in US history. Its operations are taken over by the FDIC.

Q117063486.name: 1913 Ipswich Mills strike
Q117063486.blurb: During a labor strike in Ipswich, Massachusetts, police opened fire into a crowd of strikers, killing one and injuring several others.

Q117075468.name: 2012–2014 Salvadoran gang truce
Q117075468.blurb: A truce between the Salvadoran government and gangs in the country goes into effect when 30 gang leaders are transferred to lower security prisons.

Q117084939.name: 2023 United States bank failures
Q117084939.blurb: The Swiss Government brokers a deal for UBS to buy out rival Credit Suisse in an attempt to calm the 2023 banking crisis.

Q117146543.name: 2023 Pakistani protests
Q117146543.blurb: Pakistani protests: Riots broke out following the arrest of former Pakistani prime minister Imran Khan.

Q117212534.name: Pinlaung massacre
Q117212534.blurb: The Burmese military kills at least 30 villagers, including 3 Buddhist monks, during the Pinlaung massacre in Shan State, Myanmar.

Q117220069.name: acquisition of Credit Suisse by UBS
Q117220069.blurb: The Swiss Government brokers a deal for UBS to buy out rival Credit Suisse in an attempt to calm the 2023 banking crisis.

Q117231262.name: 1920 Croatian Peasant Rebellion
Q117231262.blurb: Peasants in and around Križ began a rebellion to protest economic and conscription policies enacted by the Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes.

Q117272678.name: Leeds Convention
Q117272678.blurb: A socialist convention in Leeds, United Kingdom, called for an end to the First World War and the establishment of Workers' and Soldiers' Delegates across the country.

Q117281286.name: 2023 Australian referendum
Q117281286.blurb: Australians vote to reject a constitutional amendment that would have established an Indigenous Voice to Parliament.

Q117286524.name: Knowsley Hall shootings
Q117286524.blurb: A footman shot and killed two colleagues and wounded the lady of the house at Knowsley Hall, England.

Q117314558.name: 2023 Nashville school shooting
Q117314558.blurb: Seven people, including the perpetrator, are killed in a mass shooting at the Covenant School in Nashville, Tennessee.

Q117320430.name: Ciudad Juárez migrant center fire
Q117320430.blurb: Forty people are killed in a fire at a migrant detention facility in Ciudad Juárez, Mexico.

Q117354084.name: Tornado outbreak of March 31 – April 1, 2023
Q117354084.blurb: A historic tornado outbreak occurs in the American Midwest and South.

Q117467367.name: 2022–2023 Pentagon document leaks
aliases: United States documents leak of the Russian invasion of Ukraine
Q117467367.blurb: The house of Jack Teixeira is raided in an investigation into leaked Pentagon documents; he is arrested on the same day.

Q117486057.name: 2023 Louisville shooting
Q117486057.blurb: A mass shooting occurs at the Old National Bank in Louisville, Kentucky, that leaves five victims dead and eight wounded.

Q117595454.name: Pazigyi massacre
Q117595454.blurb: During the Pazigyi massacre, an airstrike conducted by the Myanmar Air Force kills at least 100 villagers in Pazigyi, Sagaing Region.

Q117751606.name: 801 Apennine earthquake
Q117751606.blurb: An earthquake in the Central Apennines hits Rome and Spoleto, damaging the basilica of San Paolo Fuori le Mura.

Q117815491.name: Coronation of Edward VI
Q117815491.blurb: Edward VI is crowned King of England at Westminster Abbey.

Q118112582.name: World Chess Championship 2024
Q118112582.blurb: Indian Grandmaster Gukesh Dommaraju became the undisputed World Chess Champion in a tournament held in Singapore, making him the 18th and the youngest champion in chess history.

Q118138142.name: Belgrade school shooting
Q118138142.blurb: Nine students and a security guard are killed in the Belgrade school shooting, the first attack of its kind in Serbia.

Q118146729.name: 2023–2026 Manipur conflict
Q118146729.blurb: Ethnic violence breaks out between the Meitei and the Kuki Zo people in the state of Manipur.

Q118152086.name: Mladenovac and Smederevo shootings
Q118152086.blurb: Nine people are killed and thirteen injured in a spree shooting in Mladenovac and Smederevo, Serbia. It is the second mass shooting in the country in two days.

Q118154043.name: Battle of Kalamata
Q118154043.blurb: Morean War: the Battle of Kalamata ends in a Venetian victory over the forces of the Ottoman Empire under the Kapudan Pasha.

Q118188868.name: 2023 Allen, Texas shooting
Q118188868.blurb: Eight people are killed and seven injured in a mass shooting in Allen, Texas. The perpetrator is killed by a police officer.

Q118206587.name: 2023 Tanur boat disaster
Q118206587.blurb: Tanur boat disaster: At least 22 people are killed when a boat carrying tourists capsizes in Tanur, Malappuram, Kerala, India.

Q118876010.name: St. Joseph Mutiny
Q118876010.blurb: St. Joseph Mutiny: African soldiers in the 1st West India Regiment – led by former slave trader Daaga – launch a rebellion in the British colony of Trinidad in an attempt to escape to Africa.

Q118904805.name: Schaffhausen massacre
Q118904805.blurb: Schaffhausen massacre: 30 Jews are executed, following torture, after being accused of a blood libel in Schaffhausen (in present-day Switzerland).

Q118905894.name: Emigration of Christians from the Crimea
aliases: Exodus of the Christians from the Crimea.
Q118905894.blurb: The Emigration of Christians from the Crimea in 1778 begins.

Q118906917.name: 2022 Brazilian coup plot
Q118906917.blurb: Former Brazilian president Jair Bolsonaro was sentenced to 27 years in prison for his involvement in a coup plot.

Q118979177.name: 2023 Odisha train collision
Q118979177.blurb: A collision between two passenger trains and a parked freight train near the city of Balasor, Odisha in eastern India, results in 296 deaths and more than 1,200 people injured.

Q119040941.name: May 9 riots
Q119040941.blurb: The May 9 riots following the arrest of Imran Khan in Pakistan.

Q119058509.name: 2023 Polish protests
Q119058509.blurb: Protests begin in Poland against the PiS government.

Q119104342.name: 2023 Virginia plane crash
Q119104342.blurb: Four people are killed when a Cessna Citation V crashes into Mine Bank Mountain in Augusta County, Virginia.

Q119123254.name: destruction of the Kakhovka Dam
aliases: destruction of the Nova Kakhovka Dam
The destruction of the Kakhovka Dam
Q119123254.blurb: Russo-Ukrainian war: The Kakhovka Dam is destroyed.

Q119172830.name: 2023 Senegalese protests
Q119172830.blurb: The 2024 Senegalese presidential election is held following anti-government protests.

Q119295176.name: Sack of Mecca
Q119295176.blurb: Sack of Mecca by the Qarmatians.

Q119455322.name: 2023 Nottingham attacks
Q119455322.blurb: Three people are killed and another three injured in an early morning stabbing and van ramming attack in Nottingham, England.

Q119458726.name: Kwara boat disaster
Q119458726.blurb: At least 100 people are killed when a wedding boat capsizes on the Niger River in Kwara State, Nigeria.

Q119625147.name: Battle of the Kerch Peninsula
Q119625147.blurb: World War II: The German 11th Army begins Operation Trappenjagd (Bustard Hunt) and destroys the bridgehead of the three Soviet armies defending the Kerch Peninsula.

Q119658637.name: Boundary Fire
Q119658637.blurb: In the U.S. state of Arizona, the Boundary Fire (pictured) burned out after 32 days, burning 17,788 acres (7,199 ha) of the Coconino and Kaibab National Forests.

Q119727363.name: Titan submersible implosion
Q119727363.blurb: The Titan submersible imploded during a dive to the RMS Titanic wreck, killing all five people aboard.

Q119860532.name: Wagner Group rebellion
aliases: Wagner Group attacks on the Russian leadership
Q119860532.blurb: The Wagner Group led by Yevgeny Prigozhin launches an insurrection against the Russian government.

Q120281471.name: Steamboat Monmouth disaster
Q120281471.blurb: Approximately 300 Muscogee die in the steamboat Monmouth disaster on the Trail of Tears in the United States.

Q120401897.name: World Constitutional Convention
Q120401897.blurb: Constitution for the Federation of Earth was adopted by the second session of the World Constituent Assembly, held at Innsbruck, Austria.

Q120739437.name: RTÉ secret payment scandal
Q120739437.blurb: Irish broadcaster RTÉ announced that between 2017 and 2022 it had paid €345,000 more than had been previously disclosed to presenter Ryan Tubridy (pictured).

Q120913205.name: 2023 Rolling Fork–Silver City tornado
Q120913205.blurb: An EF4 tornado strikes the towns of Rolling Fork and Silver City, Mississippi, causing mass destruction.

Q121031981.name: 2023 Khar bombing
Q121031981.blurb: In Pakistan, IS–KP kill over 60 people in a suicide bombing at a political rally in Khar.

Q121133266.name: Mughal War of Succession
Q121133266.blurb: Battle of Samugarh: Decisive battle in the struggle for the throne during the Mughal war of succession (1658–1659).

Q121213505.name: Switzerland in the Eurovision Song Contest 2024
Q121213505.blurb: The 68th edition of the Eurovision Song Contest is held in Malmö, Sweden. Nemo from Switzerland win with their song "The Code", making them the contest's first non-binary winner.

Q121324595.name: 2023 Hawaii wildfires
Q121324595.blurb: Hawaii wildfires: Seventeen thousand acres of land are burned and at least 101 people are killed, with two others missing, when a series of wildfires break out on the island of Maui in Hawaii.

Q121334219.name: Assassination of Fernando Villavicencio
Q121334219.blurb: Ecuadorian presidential candidate Fernando Villavicencio was assassinated in Quito, eleven days before the general election.

Q121357134.name: Sinéad O'Connor on Saturday Night Live
Q121357134.blurb: Sinéad O'Connor  tore up a photograph of Pope John Paul II on live television.

Q121511279.name: 2023 Slovenia floods
Q121511279.blurb: Major floods hit parts of Slovenia.

Q121789683.name: 2023 Wagner Group plane crash
aliases: Tver Oblast Wagner business jet crash
Q121789683.blurb: A business jet carrying key leadership members of the Russian private military company Wagner Group crashes, killing all ten people on board.

Q121879075.name: Bankruptcy of Penn Central
Q121879075.blurb: Penn Central declares Section 77 bankruptcy in what was the largest U.S. corporate bankruptcy to date.

Q121879706.name: 2023 Jacksonville shooting
Q121879706.blurb: Exactly 5 years after the 2018 Jacksonville Landing shooting, there is another shooting in Jacksonville, Florida, leaving 3 people dead.

Q122053772.name: 2023 Gabon coup d'état
Q122053772.blurb: Gabonese coup d'état: After Ali Bongo Ondimba's reelection, a military coup ousted him, ending 56 years of Bongo family rule in Gabon.

Q122059687.name: 1935 San Giacomo Douglas DC-2 crash
Q122059687.blurb: Switzerland: A Royal Dutch Airlines plane en route from Milan to Frankfurt crashes into a Swiss mountain, killing thirteen.

Q122166802.name: Murder of Shahzad Luqman
Q122166802.blurb: Shahzad Luqman is murdered by members of Golden Dawn in Petralona, Athens, leading the creation of new measures to combat race-based attacks in Greece.

Q122215863.name: Murder of Pai Hsiao-yen
Q122215863.blurb: Pai Hsiao-yen, daughter of Taiwanese artiste Pai Bing-bing, is kidnapped on her way to school, preceding her murder.

Q122227217.name: Wedding of Mary, Queen of Scots, and Henry, Lord Darnley
Q122227217.blurb: The widowed Mary, Queen of Scots marries Henry Stuart, Lord Darnley, Duke of Albany, at Holyrood Palace, Edinburgh, Scotland, in a Catholic ceremony.

Q122311648.name: Storm Daniel
aliases: 2023 flash floods in Greece, Turkey and Bulgaria
2023 flash floods in Greece, Turkey, and Bulgaria
Effects of Storm Daniel in Libya
Q122311648.blurb: The Libyan city of Derna experiences catastrophic floods after Storm Daniel causes two dams to collapse, killing thousands of people.

Q122351413.name: 2023 Marrakesh-Safi earthquake
Q122351413.blurb: A magnitude 6.9 earthquake strikes Morocco, killing nearly 3,000 people and damaging historic sites in Marrakesh.

Q122452171.name: Marmara earthquake of 1766
Q122452171.blurb: An earthquake in the Sea of Marmara and Gallipoli (present-day Turkey) along the North Anatolian Fault kills at least 5,000 people.

Q122469840.name: death of Sara Sharif
Q122469840.blurb: Urfan Sharif and Beinash Batool were found guilty of the murder of Sara Sharif, and were sentenced to life imprisonment.

Q122615796.name: 2023 Derna floods
Q122615796.blurb: The Libyan city of Derna experiences catastrophic floods after Storm Daniel causes two dams to collapse, killing thousands of people.

Q122700456.name: 2023 Azerbaijani offensive in Nagorno-Karabakh
Q122700456.blurb: Azerbaijan launches a military offensive against the Republic of Artsakh in the Nagorno-Karabakh region; this leads to the flight of the Armenian population.

Q122839698.name: expulsion of Nagorno-Karabakh Armenians
Q122839698.blurb: Azerbaijan launches a military offensive against the Republic of Artsakh in the Nagorno-Karabakh region; this leads to the flight of the Armenian population.

Q122853663.name: 2023 Rotterdam shooting
Q122853663.blurb: The 2023 Rotterdam shootings occurred, during which two people were killed in a shooting and arson incident at a residence in Delfshaven, Rotterdam. Additionally, one person lost their life in a classroom at the Erasmus University Medical Center.

Q122955540.name: 1976 Brownwood tornado
Q122955540.blurb: A violent F5 tornado strikes around Brownwood, Texas, injuring 11 people. Two people were thrown at least 1,000 yards (910 m) by the tornado and survived uninjured.

Q122962941.name: Gaza War
aliases: 2023 Israeli ground offensive in the Gaza Strip
2023 Israeli ground operation in the Gaza Strip
2023 Israeli ground operations in the Gaza Strip
2023 Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip
2023-2024 Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip
2023–2024 Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip
Iranian involvement in the Israel-Hamas war
Iranian involvement in the Israel–Hamas war
Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip
Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip (2023)
Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip (2023-present)
Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip (2023–present)
Q122962941.blurb: Gaza war: Israel Defense Forces killed 15 aid workers in the Rafah paramedic massacre.

Q122975233.name: Re'im music festival massacre
aliases: Hamas’ attack on Israel’s Supernova Music Festival
Q122975233.blurb: The military wing of the Palestinian nationalist Islamist political organization Hamas massacred people attending an open-air music festival in southern Israel.

Q122976243.name: October 7 attacks
aliases: Hamas' attack on Israel on 7 October 2023
Preparations for 2023 Hamas attack on Israel
Q122976243.blurb: Palestinian nationalist groups launched armed incursions into the Gaza envelope, starting the Gaza war.

Q122983377.name: 1970 Berrechid crash
Q122983377.blurb: A Royal Air Maroc Sud Aviation Caravelle crashes near Berrechid, Morocco, killing 61.

Q123005094.name: Israel–Hamas war hostage crisis
Q123005094.blurb: Hamas and several other Palestinian militant groups launch an attack into Israel, which results in the deaths of around 1,200, mostly civilians, and the taking of 251 hostages, including civilians and soldiers. The attack initiated the Gaza war and the larger Middle Eastern crisis.

Q123109101.name: al-Ahli Arab Hospital explosion
aliases: attack on Baptist hospital in Gaza
Q123109101.blurb: An explosion at Al-Ahli Arab Hospital in Gaza kills hundreds of Palestinians during the Gaza war.

Q123188898.name: 2023 Lewiston shootings
Q123188898.blurb: A mass shooting occurs in two locations in Lewiston, Maine. 18 people are killed and 13 more injured.

Q123266183.name: American Airlines Flight 009
Q123266183.blurb: American Airlines Flight 009 crashes near Rural Retreat, Virginia, killing 17.

Q123279245.name: Operation Encore
Q123279245.blurb: World War II: American and Brazilian troops kick off Operation Encore in Northern Italy, a successful limited action in the Northern Apennines that prepares for the western portion of the Allied Spring offensive.

Q123459518.name: 2023 Cricket World Cup final
Q123459518.blurb: The 2023 Cricket World Cup final takes place at the Narendra Modi Stadium in Ahmedabad, India, played between host nation India and Australia.

Q123577949.name: 1939 Liechtenstein putsch
Q123577949.blurb: The 1939 Liechtenstein putsch takes place; approximately 40 members of the VBDL starting from Nendeln march towards Vaduz with the intention of overthrowing the government and provoking Liechtenstein's annexation into Germany.

Q123592354.name: Treaty of Drottningholm
Q123592354.blurb: Treaty of Drottningholm, between Sweden and Russia

Q123593181.name: Wedding of Mary, Queen of Scots, and Francis, Dauphin of France
Q123593181.blurb: Mary, Queen of Scots, marries the Dauphin of France, François, at Notre-Dame de Paris.

Q123668173.name: 2023 eruption of Mount Marapi
Q123668173.blurb: Mount Marapi located in West Sumatra, Indonesia begins a sporadic series of eruptions. 23 people were killed, and 12 were injured.

Q123700076.name: Sonderkommando Revolt in Auschwitz
Q123700076.blurb: World War II: The Sonderkommando Revolt in Auschwitz was an uprising of prisoners (especially the Sonderkommando) at the Auschwitz concentration camp, they burnt down Crematorium IV.

Q123822981.name: Westside Middle School Shooting
Q123822981.blurb: Mitchell Johnson and Andrew Golden, aged 11 and 13 respectively, open fire upon teachers and students at Westside Middle School in Jonesboro, Arkansas; five people are killed and ten are wounded.

Q123856701.name: Rescue of Ori Megidish
Q123856701.blurb: First rescue of a prisoner during the Israeli invasion of Gaza.

Q123925297.name: 1912 suspension of Ty Cobb
Q123925297.blurb: During a match, baseball star Ty Cobb enters the stands and assaults a fan who had heckled him, leading to his suspension.

Q123952055.name: 2023 Prague shooting
Q123952055.blurb: Fourteen people are killed and 25 others injured during a mass shooting at Charles University in Prague, Czech Republic.

Q124000667.name: 2023 Serbian election protests
Q124000667.blurb: A series of mass protests began in Belgrade, Serbia, alleging electoral irregularities in the Serbian parliament and Belgrade city assembly elections.

Q124020336.name: 2023 Plateau State massacres
Q124020336.blurb: A series of massacres targeting Berom civilians unfold in the Plateau State in Nigeria, killing over 200 people and further injuring over 500. No group claims responsibility.

Q124058909.name: Abdication of Margrethe II
aliases: Abdication of Margrethe II of Denmark
Abdication of Queen Margrethe II of Denmark
Proclamation of King Frederick X of Denmark
Q124058909.blurb: Queen Margrethe II abdicates as Queen of Denmark and is succeeded by her son, Frederik X.

Q124060919.name: 2024 Noto earthquake
aliases: 2024 Sea of Japan earthquake and tsunami
Q124060919.blurb: A 7.5 Mww earthquake strikes the western coast of Japan, killing more than 500 people and injuring over 1,000 others. A majority of direct deaths were due to collapsed homes.

Q124062329.name: 1871 Liberian coup d'état
Q124062329.blurb: Liberian President Edward James Roye is deposed in a coup d'état.

Q124078312.name: 2024 Haneda Airport runway collision
Q124078312.blurb: Two aircraft collide on a runway at Haneda Airport in Tokyo, killing 5 and injuring 18.

Q124086054.name: Gaza genocide
aliases: Allegations of genocide by Israel in the 2023 Israel-Hamas war
Allegations of genocide by Israel in the 2023 Israel–Hamas war
Allegations of genocide in the 2023 Israeli attack on Gaza
Allegations of genocide in the 2023-2024 Israel-Gaza War on Israel
Attempted genocide by Israel in their 2023 attack on Gaza
Genocide allegations in the 2023 Israeli attack on Gaza
Q124086054.blurb: South Africa files a genocide case against Israel at the International Court of Justice over Israeli conducts in the Gaza Strip.

Q124098799.name: 2024 Kerman bombings
Q124098799.blurb: At least 91 people are killed in bombings in Kerman, Iran, during a ceremony commemorating the assassination of Iranian General Qasem Soleimani four years earlier.

Q124154410.name: Alaska Airlines Flight 1282 on 5 January 2024
Q124154410.blurb: Alaska Airlines Flight 1282 makes an emergency landing at Portland International Airport after a door plug blows off the Boeing 737 MAX 9 operating the flight. There are no fatalities, but the accident prompts the 737 MAX to be grounded and renews scrutiny on Boeing's manufacturing and design issues.

Q124284970.name: Andrew Johnson's drunken vice-presidential inaugural address
Q124284970.blurb: U.S. politician Andrew Johnson makes his drunk vice-presidential inaugural address in Washington, D.C.

Q124328742.name: Battle of Candlestick
Q124328742.blurb: Juan Marichal, pitcher for the San Francisco Giants, strikes John Roseboro, catcher for the Los Angeles Dodgers, on the head with a bat, sparking a 14-minute brawl, one of the most violent on-field incidents in sports history.

Q124334012.name: Assassination of Bachir Gemayel
Q124334012.blurb: President-elect of Lebanon Bachir Gemayel is assassinated.

Q124336578.name: Rotter kidnapping
Q124336578.blurb: Nazi sympathisers attempted to kidnap two German-Jewish filmmakers in Liechtenstein.

Q124339025.name: Adil Shahi–Portuguese conflicts
Q124339025.blurb: Adil Shahi–Portuguese conflicts: Afonso de Albuquerque, the governor of Portuguese India, led an armada to conquer Goa.

Q124344710.name: Transvestism and Transsexuality in Modern Society
Q124344710.blurb: Transvestism and Transsexualism in Modern Society, the UK's first trans-rights conference, opened with an evening reception in Leeds.

Q124347566.name: 2024 Korochansky Ilyushin Il-76 crash
Q124347566.blurb: An Ilyushin Il-76 crashes in Russia's Korochansky District, killing all 74 people on board.

Q124358186.name: 1973 New York City gravediggers' strike
Q124358186.blurb: About 1,700 gravediggers in New York City began a 12-week strike, causing a delay in the burial of roughly 1,400 bodies in the city.

Q124373310.name: Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)
Q124373310.blurb: Hamas and several other Palestinian militant groups launch an attack into Israel, which results in the deaths of around 1,200, mostly civilians, and the taking of 251 hostages, including civilians and soldiers. The attack initiated the Gaza war and the larger Middle Eastern crisis.

Q124381819.name: 1038 Dingxiang earthquake
Q124381819.blurb: An earthquake in Dingxiang, China kills an estimated 32,300.

Q124450799.name: 2024 Balochistan bombings
Q124450799.blurb: Pakistan election offices are hit by twin bombings, killing at least 24 people a day before general elections.

Q124528560.name: Killing of Jerry McCabe
Q124528560.blurb: The Irish Criminal Assets Bureau was established following the gangland murders of Detective Garda Jerry McCabe and investigative journalist Veronica Guerin.

Q124638973.name: Coronation of Charles X
Q124638973.blurb: The Coronation of Charles X of France takes place in Reims Cathedral, the last-ever coronation of a French monarch.

Q124695144.name: Flour Massacre
Q124695144.blurb: The Flour Massacre took place in the Gaza Strip: Israeli forces opened fire on Palestinians waiting for aid amidst the Gaza war, killing over 100 and wounding 750.

Q124749327.name: Battle of Raft Swamp
Q124749327.blurb: The Battle of Raft Swamp marks the last battle fought in North Carolina during the American Revolutionary War with a Patriot victory. It occurred four days before the British surrender at Yorktown.

Q124784012.name: 1973 Nobel Peace Prize
Q124784012.blurb: The Norwegian Nobel Committee announced that the 1973 Nobel Peace Prize would be jointly awarded to Henry Kissinger and Lê Đức Thọ, sparking international controversy.

Q125092492.name: Crocus City Hall attack
aliases: International reactions to the Crocus City Hall attack
Q125092492.blurb: At least 151 people are killed and 609 injured in a bombing and mass shooting at the Crocus City Hall in Krasnogorsk, Russia.

Q125119195.name: Battle of Chasiv Yar
Q125119195.blurb: Russo-Ukrainian war: The Battle of Chasiv Yar begins.

Q125131496.name: 1819 Balloon Riot
Q125131496.blurb: 1819 Balloon riot occurred at Vauxhall Garden in Philadelphia, PA and resulted in the destruction of the amusement park.

Q125145943.name: Francis Scott Key Bridge collapse
aliases: Collapse of the Francis Scott Key Bridge
Francis Scott Key Bridge collapse and replacement timeline
Q125145943.blurb: The Francis Scott Key Bridge collapses following a collision between the MV Dali container ship and one of the bridge's support pillars, killing six people.

Q125266320.name: Viertola school shooting
Q125266320.blurb: Viertola school shooting: A 12-year-old pupil is killed and two others injured by a shooter of the same age in Vantaa, Finland.

Q125457538.name: 2024 Westfield Bondi Junction stabbings
Q125457538.blurb: Six people and the perpetrator are killed and twelve others injured in a mass stabbing at Westfield Bondi Junction shopping centre in Sydney, Australia.

Q125504601.name: 2024 Persian Gulf floods
Q125504601.blurb: Flooding in the Persian Gulf starts, killing 19 in Oman.

Q125522956.name: Coronation of Louis XVI
Q125522956.blurb: The Coronation of Louis XVI in Reims, the last coronation before the French Revolution.

Q125549897.name: assassination of Ahmad Shah Massoud
Q125549897.blurb: Two al-Qaeda attackers assassinated Ahmad Shah Massoud, a pivotal Afghan resistance leader, two days before the September 11 attacks in the United States.

Q125564521.name: 2024 Lumut mid-air collision
Q125564521.blurb: The 2024 Lumut mid-air collision in Malaysia kills 10 people while rehearsing for the 90th anniversary of the Royal Malaysian Navy.

Q125627220.name: 2026 Hungarian parliamentary election
Q125627220.blurb: The Tisza Party, led by Péter Magyar wins the 2026 Hungarian parliamentary election, defeating Viktor Orbán's Fidesz party, which had ruled the country for 16 years, marking the first change in government in Hungary for over a decade.

Q125727611.name: Battle of Hims
Q125727611.blurb: An Egyptian army under Ibrahim Pascha defeats an Ottoman army under Mehmed Pascha in the battle of Hims.

Q125759097.name: Siege of Akka
Q125759097.blurb: An Egyptian army under Ibrahim Pasha captures Acre from the Ottomans after a five-months siege.

Q125867324.name: St. Louis Blues–Philadelphia Flyers brawl
Q125867324.blurb: A brawl broke out between players, fans, and police officers during an ice hockey game between the Philadelphia Flyers and the St. Louis Blues in Philadelphia.

Q125876060.name: May 2024 solar storms
Q125876060.blurb: Start of the May 2024 solar storms, the most powerful set of geomagnetic storms since the 2003 Halloween solar storms.

Q125895337.name: 1973 Concorde eclipse flight
Q125895337.blurb: Concorde 001 intercepts the path of a total solar eclipse and follows the moon's shadow, experiencing the longest total eclipse observation.

Q125937931.name: attempted assassination of Robert Fico
Q125937931.blurb: Prime Minister of Slovakia Robert Fico is shot and critically injured while meeting with supporters at an event in Handlová.

Q125986235.name: 2024 Varzaqan helicopter crash
Q125986235.blurb: A helicopter crash in Iran leaves 8 people dead, including the country's president Ebrahim Raisi & foreign minister Hossein Amir-Abdollahian.

Q125996412.name: 1997 Jarrell tornado
Q125996412.blurb: A destructive F5-rated tornado tracked through a subdivision of homes northwest of Jarrell, Texas, killing 27 people.

Q126017034.name: Great Martyrdom of Edo
Q126017034.blurb: 50 Christians are executed in Edo, Japan, during the Great Martyrdom of Edo.

Q126024247.name: 2024 Taichung Metro attack
Q126024247.blurb: A stabbing spree on the Green line of the Taichung MRT injures four people, including the perpetrator.

Q126126383.name: Suicidal Tour
Q126126383.blurb: After suffering train derailments, defections, and outbreaks of dysentery and typhoid fever which killed two members, the Brazilian football club Santa Cruz returned from their Suicidal Tour (team pictured).

Q126366737.name: First Qarmatian invasion of Egypt
Q126366737.blurb: Battle of Ayn Shams: The Fatimids under Jawhar defeat the Qarmatians at the gates of Cairo, putting an end to the First Qarmatian invasion of Egypt.

Q126391651.name: Charleston Workhouse Slave Rebellion
Q126391651.blurb: The Charleston Workhouse Slave Rebellion begins in Charleston, South Carolina, United States.

Q126488839.name: Australian Eastern Mission
Q126488839.blurb: The landmark Australian Eastern Mission led by John Latham departs on its three-month tour of East and South-East Asia.

Q126489536.name: 2024 Chikangawa Dornier 228 crash
Q126489536.blurb: A plane crash in Malawi leaves 10 people dead, including the country's Vice President Saulos Chilima.

Q126539425.name: 2024 Mangaf Building Fire
Q126539425.blurb: A fire in a residential building in Mangaf, Kuwait City kills at least 50 people.

Q126721295.name: Henry Morgan's raid on Lake Maracaibo
Q126721295.blurb: Henry Morgan's raid on Lake Maracaibo: the Spanish Armada de Barlovento is defeated by an English Privateer fleet led by Captain Henry Morgan.

Q126870355.name: 1947 Dustabad earthquake
Q126870355.blurb: A magnitude 6.9 earthquake strikes South Khorasan in Iran, killing over 500 people.

Q126902909.name: Siege of Coron (1685)
Q126902909.blurb: Morean War: The 49-day Siege of Coron ends with the surrender and massacre of its garrison by the Venetians.

Q126915304.name: 2024 storming of the Kenyan Parliament
Q126915304.blurb: Thousands of people storm Kenya's Parliament Buildings protesting the passing of the government's 2024/25 Finance Bill.

Q126919562.name: Joe Biden–Donald Trump 2024 presidential debate
Q126919562.blurb: U.S. President Joe Biden debates former U.S. President Donald Trump. Biden's perceived poor performance leads to his withdrawal from the election on July 21.

Q126962859.name: 2024 Hathras stampede
Q126962859.blurb: A stampede during a religious event in Uttar Pradesh, India, leaves at least 121 people dead and 150 others injured.

Q127108371.name: 2014 Midwest FurFest gas attack
Q127108371.blurb: The annual furry convention Midwest FurFest is targeted in an unsolved chlorine gas attack.

Q127273725.name: 1946 Palestine general strike
Q127273725.blurb: About 500 postal workers in Tel Aviv and Jaffa went on strike.

Q127273736.name: 1984 Braves–Padres bean brawl
Q127273736.blurb: An infamous brawl takes place at the Atlanta-Fulton County Stadium between the Atlanta Braves and San Diego Padres.

Q127328941.name: 2024 Greenfield tornado
Q127328941.blurb: The Greenfield tornado kills five and injures 35 across rural Iowa, United States. Wind speeds in excess of 480 kilometres per hour (300 mph) are estimated from measurements for the third time in history.

Q127413252.name: Gazpromavia Flight 9608
Q127413252.blurb: Gazpromavia Flight 9608 crashes in Russia's Kolomensky District near Kolomna, killing three.

Q127433549.blurb: An Egyptian army under Ibrahim Pascha defeats a larger Ottoman army in the battle of Belen Pass.

Q127688121.name: Kamala Harris 2024 presidential campaign
Q127688121.blurb: U.S. President Joe Biden announces he will no longer seek a second term and withdraws from the 2024 election, endorsing Vice President Kamala Harris as she launches her own presidential campaign.

Q127698512.name: withdrawal of Lyndon B. Johnson from the 1968 United States presidential election
Q127698512.blurb: American President Lyndon B. Johnson speaks to the nation of "Steps to Limit the War in Vietnam" in a television address. At the conclusion of his speech, he announces: "I shall not seek, and I will not accept, the nomination of my party for another term as your President."

Q127784533.name: 2024 Saurya Airlines Bombardier CRJ200 crash
Q127784533.blurb: A Saurya Airlines Bombardier CRJ200 crashes during takeoff from Tribhuvan International Airport in Kathmandu, Nepal, killing 18.

Q128034940.name: 2024 Southport stabbings
Q128034940.blurb: Three children are stabbed to death and 10 other people injured at a dance studio in Southport, England. This incident, coupled with widespread online misinformation, leads to various racially motivated riots across the UK.

Q128098219.name: 2024 Wayanad landslide
Q128098219.blurb: A series of landslides occurs in Kerala, India, causing over 420 fatalities.

Q128239204.name: Treaty of Paris (1808)
Q128239204.blurb: The Treaty of Paris is signed ending the French military occupation of Prussia.

Q128281666.name: 2024 United Kingdom riots
Q128281666.blurb: Three children are stabbed to death and 10 other people injured at a dance studio in Southport, England. This incident, coupled with widespread online misinformation, leads to various racially motivated riots across the UK.

Q128401697.name: Non-cooperation movement (2024)
Q128401697.blurb: Following the non-cooperation movement against the government of Bangladesh, Bangladeshi prime minister Sheikh Hasina resigns and flees the country, ending her rule of 15 consecutive years and a total of almost two decades. The date is also known as 36 July.

Q128601735.name: Resignation of Sheikh Hasina
Q128601735.blurb: Following the non-cooperation movement against the government of Bangladesh, Bangladeshi prime minister Sheikh Hasina resigns and flees the country, ending her rule of 15 consecutive years and a total of almost two decades. The date is also known as 36 July.

Q128796456.name: Voepass Linhas Aéreas Flight 2283
Q128796456.blurb: Voepass Linhas Aéreas Flight 2283 crashes near Vinhedo, São Paulo, killing all 62 people on board.

Q128797880.name: 2026 Bangladeshi general election
Q128797880.blurb: In the first general election since the July Revolution in Bangladesh, the Bangladesh Nationalist Party, led by Tarique Rahman, wins a landslide victory upon returning to power after almost 19 years. A referendum held alongside was also approved by the majority of voters.

Q128799073.name: Al-Tabaeen school attack
Q128799073.blurb: Israel strikes Al-Tabaeen school in eastern Gaza City, killing at least 80 Palestinians.

Q128800321.name: 2015 Garland tornado
Q128800321.blurb: A violent EF-4 tornado hits Garland, Texas, killing nine and injuring almost 500 others.

Q129015748.name: July 36
Q129015748.blurb: Following the non-cooperation movement against the government of Bangladesh, Bangladeshi prime minister Sheikh Hasina resigns and flees the country, ending her rule of 15 consecutive years and a total of almost two decades. The date is also known as 36 July.

Q129491729.name: Palestinian suicide attacks
Q129491729.blurb: A Palestinian suicide bomber detonated explosives in a restaurant in Tel Aviv, Israel, killing 11 people and injuring 70 others.

Q129677496.name: Storm Ulysses
Q129677496.blurb: Storm Ulysses struck Ireland, felling thousands of trees and causing damage to up to a quarter of all houses in Dublin.

Q129903635.name: Live '25 Tour
Q129903635.blurb: The Oasis Live '25 tour begins in Principality Stadium, Cardiff, ending a 16-year hiatus.

Q130050710.name: Antioch earthquake of 528
Q130050710.blurb: Antioch suffers its second major earthquake in two years, killing thousands and destroying its remaining edifice.

Q130215030.name: 2024 Kamchatka Mil Mi-8 crash
Q130215030.blurb: A helicopter crashes in Kamchatka Krai in the Russian Far East, killing all 22 occupants.

Q130233415.name: 2024 Makala prison jailbreak attempt
Q130233415.blurb: At least 129 inmates are killed and 59 more injured in an attempted prison break at Makala Prison in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo.

Q130233794.name: Cumbres case
Q130233794.blurb: In Monterrey, Mexico, a man identified as Diego Santoy Riveroll commits a double murder against two children, followed by an attempted murder of his ex-partner, Erika. The incident is popularly known as the Cumbres case.

Q130236251.name: 2024 Apalachee High School shooting
aliases: Four killed in Apalachee High School shooting in Georgia, United States
Q130236251.blurb: A 14-year-old gunman kills four people and injures seven in a mass shooting at Apalachee High School near Winder, Georgia.

Q130255015.name: July Revolution
Q130255015.blurb: In the first general election since the July Revolution in Bangladesh, the Bangladesh Nationalist Party, led by Tarique Rahman, wins a landslide victory upon returning to power after almost 19 years. A referendum held alongside was also approved by the majority of voters.

Q130266758.name: Hurricane Francine
Q130266758.blurb: Hurricane Francine impacts the Gulf of Mexico, as a Category 2 hurricane.

Q130322610.name: 1994 Solar Temple massacres
Q130322610.blurb: Swiss police find the bodies of 48 members of the Order of the Solar Temple, who had died in a cult mass murder-suicide.

Q130329389.name: Des Moines speech
Q130329389.blurb: Charles Lindbergh makes his Des Moines speech accusing the British, Jews and FDR's administration of conspiring for war with Germany.

Q130344938.name: Battle of Chieveley
Q130344938.blurb: Second Boer War: Battle of Chieveley, a British armored train is ambushed and partially derailed. British lose the battle, with 80 soldiers captured, along with war correspondent Winston Churchill.

Q130354504.name: September 2024 Israeli attacks against Lebanon
Q130354504.blurb: Israel launches airstrikes against Hezbollah targets in Lebanon, killing more than 490 people.

Q130358528.name: Hurricane Helene
Q130358528.blurb: Hurricane Helene makes landfall in Perry, Florida as a Category 4 hurricane, killing over 250 people, causing US$78.7 billion in damage and becoming the deadliest hurricane in the mainland United States since Katrina.

Q130388076.name: 2024 Lebanon War
aliases: Allegations of genocide in the 2024 Israeli invasion of Lebanon
Q130388076.blurb: Israel invaded Southern Lebanon, marking the fifth Israeli invasion of Lebanon since 1978.

Q130428849.name: Hurricane Milton
aliases: Effects of Hurricane Milton in Florida
United States Congress hearings on Hurricane Milton
Q130428849.blurb: Hurricane Milton makes landfall in Siesta Key, Florida, as a Category 3 hurricane, causing US$34.3 billion in damage only two weeks after Hurricane Helene impacted the state.

Q130483754.name: Killing of Nick Berg
Q130483754.blurb: American businessman Nick Berg is beheaded by Islamist militants. The act is recorded on videotape and released on the Internet.

Q130553385.name: Pro-Fatimid conspiracy against Saladin
Q130553385.blurb: A conspiracy against Saladin, aiming to restore the Fatimid Caliphate, is revealed in Cairo, involving senior figures of the former Fatimid regime and the poet Umara al-Yamani. Modern historians doubt the extent and danger of the conspiracy reported in official sources, but its ringleaders will be publicly executed over the following weeks.

Q130693551.name: Battle of al-Funaydiq
Q130693551.blurb: The Mirdasids defeat the Fatimid Caliphate at the Battle of al-Funaydiq, signalling the definitive loss of Aleppo for the Fatimids.

Q130752136.name: Novi Sad railway station canopy collapse
aliases: Novi Sad railway station roof collapse
Q130752136.blurb: A concrete canopy collapses at the Novi Sad railway station, killing 16 people and injuring 3.

Q131152711.name: 2024 Zhuhai car attack
Q131152711.blurb: A vehicle-ramming attack in Zhuhai, China, kills 38 people and injures 48.

Q131345189.name: 2007 Greensburg tornado
Q131345189.blurb: Greensburg, Kansas is almost completely destroyed by the 2007 Greensburg tornado, a 1.7-mile wide EF5 tornado. It was the first-ever tornado to be rated with the new Enhanced Fujita scale.

Q131380778.name: 2024 South Korean martial law crisis
aliases: 2024 Declaration of martial law in South Korea
2024 South Korean declaration of martial law
2024 South Korean self coup d'etat attempt
Martial law in South Korea under Yoon Suk Yeol
Martial law under Yoon Suk Yeol

Q131380778.blurb: Martial law is declared in South Korea.

Q131384112.name: Impeachment of Yoon Suk Yeol
aliases: Attempted impeachment of Yoon Suk Yeol
Impeachment motion against Yoon Suk Yeol
Impeachment process against Yoon Suk Yeol
Q131384112.blurb: The impeachment of President Yoon Suk Yeol of South Korea in response to his declaration of martial law is unanimously upheld by the country's Constitutional Court, ending his presidency.

Q131389544.name: killing of Brian Thompson
Q131389544.blurb: UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson is shot and killed in Manhattan, New York City near the entrance of the New York Hilton Midtown.

Q131394203.name: Uusimaa blockade
Q131394203.blurb: The region of Uusimaa (with the capital city Helsinki) is temporarily isolated from the rest of Finland due to increased COVID-19 infections.

Q131401087.name: Fall of Damascus
Q131401087.blurb: Battle of Damascus (2024): Syrian opposition forces enter the Rif Dimashq Governorate, reaching within 20 km of the capital Damascus.

Q131404510.name: Fall of the Assad regime
aliases: Collapse of the Syrian Arab Republic
Dissolution of the Syrian Arab Republic
Fall of the Syrian Arab Republic
Q131404510.blurb: Damascus falls to rebels after Syrian troops withdraw and president Bashar al-Assad leaves the country as his government collapses. Israel as a result invaded into the buffer zone between Syria and the Israeli-occupied Golan Heights.

Q131405504.name: Israeli invasion of Syria
aliases: Israeli attacks against the fleet in 2024
Spillover of the Gaza war in Syria
Q131405504.blurb: Damascus falls to rebels after Syrian troops withdraw and president Bashar al-Assad leaves the country as his government collapses. Israel as a result invaded into the buffer zone between Syria and the Israeli-occupied Golan Heights.

Q131425516.name: Aloha IslandAir Flight 1712
Q131425516.blurb: Aloha Island Air Flight 1712, a Twin Otter 300, crashed into terrain at night in Hawaii killing all 20 occupants onboard.

Q131441044.name: Carmaux-Bons Enfants bombing
Q131441044.blurb: The Carmaux-Bons Enfants bombing marks the start of Émile Henry's attacks into the Ère des attentats (1892–1894).

Q131442245.name: Terminus bombing
Q131442245.blurb: Café Terminus bombing by Émile Henry during the Ère des attentats (1892–1894). This is considered one of the first acts of modern terrorism.

Q131455297.name: Abundant Life Christian School shooting
Q131455297.blurb: The Abundant Life Christian School shooting in Madison, Wisconsin, United States, takes place, resulting in the death of three people.

Q131459722.name: Remarks at the Islamic Center of Washington
Q131459722.blurb: American president George W. Bush delivered remarks at the Islamic Center of Washington (pictured) condemning Islamophobia in the aftermath of the September 11 attacks.

Q131519933.name: Zagreb school stabbing
Q131519933.blurb: A mass stabbing occurs in a primary school in Zagreb, Croatia, in which a 7-year-old pupil is killed and six more are injured by a knife-wielding 19-year-old male.

Q131520015.name: 2024 Magdeburg car attack
Q131520015.blurb: Six people are killed and over 200 are injured when an anti-Islam activist drives a car into a crowd at a Christmas market in Magdeburg, Germany.

Q131552728.name: Azerbaijan Airlines Flight 8243
Q131552728.blurb: Azerbaijan Airlines Flight 8243 crashes in Aktau, Kazakhstan, killing 38 of its occupants.

Q131564576.name: assassination of Abdullah I of Jordan
Q131564576.blurb: King Abdullah I of Jordan is assassinated by a Palestinian while attending Friday prayers in Jerusalem.

Q131567305.name: Impeachment of Han Duck-soo
Q131567305.blurb: Acting president and prime minister of South Korea Han Duck-soo  was impeached by the National Assembly.

Q131581945.name: Jeju Air Flight 2216
Q131581945.blurb: Jeju Air Flight 2216 crashes into a wall in Muan, South Korea, killing 179 of the 181 occupants. It is the worst aircraft accident on South Korean soil in history.

Q131611708.name: 2025 New Orleans truck attack
aliases: 2025 New Orleans New Year's Day attack
Q131611708.blurb: Fourteen people are killed and 57 others injured during a vehicle-ramming and shooting attack in New Orleans, Louisiana.

Q131626210.name: Florida State University academic-athletic scandal
Q131626210.blurb: As part of their investigation into an athletic scandal at Florida State University, the National Collegiate Athletic Association released a report alleging that 61 student athletes had engaged in academic fraud.

Q131704535.name: January 2025 Southern California wildfires
Q131704535.blurb: A series of wildfires ravage the Greater Los Angeles area, resulting in at least 16 deaths and 13,401 structures destroyed.

Q131839191.name: Grand Kartal fire
Q131839191.blurb: A fire at the Grand Kartal Hotel in the Kartalkaya ski resort in Bolu Province, Turkey, results in 78 people dead and 51 injured.

Q131904729.name: February 1987 Palestinian unrest
Q131904729.blurb: Civil unrest broke out across Palestine.

Q131916904.name: 2025 Masters Tournament
Q131916904.blurb: Rory McIlroy wins the Masters Tournament, becoming just the sixth person to complete the Grand Slam in golf.

Q131933374.name: 1862 Brooklyn riot
Q131933374.blurb: In Brooklyn, a mob composed largely of Irish Americans attacked a group of African Americans in a riot.

Q131933497.name: 1992 deportation of Hamas members
Q131933497.blurb: Deportation of Hamas members: Israeli authorities began deporting hundreds of Palestinians suspected to be members of Hamas across the Lebanese border.

Q131934433.name: 2025 Light Air Services Beechcraft 1900 crash
Q131934433.blurb: A chartered Beechcraft 1900 crashes near the Unity oilfield in South Sudan, killing 20 people.

Q131936357.name: 2025 Potomac River mid-air collision
Q131936357.blurb: American Eagle Flight 5342 collided mid-air with a Sikorsky UH-60 Black Hawk operated by the United States Army and crashed into the Potomac River, killing all 67 people on board both aircraft.

Q131990794.name: Med Jets Flight 056
aliases: 2025 Jet Rescue Air Ambulance Learjet 55 crash
Jet Rescue Air Ambulance flight MTS056
Q131990794.blurb: Med Jets Flight 056 crashes near Roosevelt Mall in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, killing 8 people and injuring 23.

Q132132116.name: 2025 Risbergska school shooting
Q132132116.blurb: Ten people are killed in a mass shooting at an adult education centre in Örebro, Sweden.

Q132146765.name: 1944 Shinnston tornado
Q132146765.blurb: An F4 tornado tears through the Appalachian Mountains, killing over 100 people in West Virginia, particularly in the town of Shinnston.

Q132146859.name: 1989 visit by Boris Yeltsin to the United States
Q132146859.blurb: During a tour of the United States, Soviet politician Boris Yeltsin visited a grocery store in Texas that had a major impact on his views regarding the Soviet Union's economic system.

Q132170670.name: Luka Dončić trade
Q132170670.blurb: Slovenian NBA player Luka Doncic is traded from the Dallas Mavericks to the Los Angeles Lakers in exchange for Anthony Davis in one of the largest trades in American sports history.

Q132175180.name: Capitulation of Madrid
Q132175180.blurb: Napoleonic Wars: Under the orders by commander Tomás de Morla, the city of Madrid surrenders to French Emperor Napoleon I after a 4 day long siege.

Q132541461.name: Ère des attentats
Q132541461.blurb: Ère des attentats: In one of the first acts of modern terrorism, Émile Henry threw a bomb into Café Terminus  in Paris, France, killing one person and injuring 17 more.

Q132722679.name: Véry bombing
Q132722679.blurb: Véry bombing during the Ère des attentats (1892–1894).

Q132797985.name: Fourth Spanish Armada
Q132797985.blurb: 4th Spanish Armada makes landfall in Ireland at Kinsale.

Q132802345.name: Saint-Germain bombing
Q132802345.blurb: The Saint-Germain bombing ushers France into the Ère des attentats (1892-1894).

Q132820535.name: Exhibition of 1761
Q132820535.blurb: Exhibition of 1761, the inaugural exhibition of the Society of Artists of Great Britain, opens at Spring Gardens in London.

Q133209569.name: Lobau bombing
Q133209569.blurb: The Lobau bombing is one of the first attacks of the Ère des attentats (1892-1894).

Q133235838.name: 1972 Las Palomas mid-air collision
Q133235838.blurb: Two Avianca Douglas DC-3 airliners collide over Colombia, killing 38.

Q133248037.name: 20 February bombings
Q133248037.blurb: 20 February bombings by Désiré Pauwels during the Ère des attentats (1892-1894).

Q133250764.name: Madeleine bombing
Q133250764.blurb: Madeleine bombing by Désiré Pauwels during the Ère des attentats.

Q133278338.name: 1967 Belvidere tornado
Q133278338.blurb: A violent tornado strikes multiple schools and destroys houses in Belvidere, Illinois, United States, causing over 450 casualties.

Q133285532.name: 13 November 1893 stabbing
Q133285532.blurb: 13 November stabbing is committed by Léon Léauthier during the Ère des attentats. This is an influential event in the birth of modern terrorism.

Q133288049.name: Kočani nightclub fire
Q133288049.blurb: A fire breaks out in a nightclub in Kočani, North Macedonia, killing at least 59 people and injuring 155 others.

Q133309815.name: Operation Might and Sword
Q133309815.blurb: Israel launches widespread aerial bombardments and attacks on the Gaza Strip, killing at least 591 people, including children.

Q133444099.name: National Assembly bombing
Q133444099.blurb: National Assembly bombing by Auguste Vaillant during the Ère des attentats (1892–1894).

Q133539824.name: Death and funeral of Francisco Franco
Q133539824.blurb: After the death of dictator Francisco Franco in 1975, the first democratic elections take place in Spain.

Q133574091.name: 2025 Myanmar earthquake
Q133574091.blurb: An earthquake strikes close to Mandalay, Myanmar with a magnitude of 7.7, killing over 5400 people.

Q133752723.name: 1862 mass execution at Mankato
Q133752723.blurb: Dakota War of 1862: The largest mass-hanging in U.S. history takes place in Mankato, Minnesota, where 38 Native American prisoners are hanged.

Q133800245.name: Cory Booker's marathon speech
Q133800245.blurb: U.S. Senator Strom Thurmond begins a filibuster to prevent the United States Senate from voting on the Civil Rights Act of 1957; he stopped speaking 24 hours and 18 minutes later. This would remain the longest speech ever conducted by a single Senator until Cory Booker spoke for 25 hours and five minutes, beginning on March 31, 2025.

Q133815096.name: Liberation Day tariffs
aliases: Regulating Imports with a Reciprocal Tariff to Rectify Trade Practices that Contribute to Large and Persistent Annual United States Goods Trade Deficits
Q133815096.blurb: Liberation Day tariffs: U.S. President Donald Trump announces sweeping worldwide tariffs.

Q133818618.name: March 2025 Rafah humanitarian convoy attacks
Q133818618.blurb: Israel Defense Forces kill 15 aid workers in the Rafah paramedic massacre.

Q133821312.name: Lebanese Council of 1736
Q133821312.blurb: The Lebanese Council of 1736 begins, a major turning point in the reform of the Maronite Church. In the following three days, the assembled Maronite and Latin clergy presided by Yusuf ibn Siman as-Simani discuss various reforms and elaborate rules and canons.

Q133860300.name: 1931 Birmingham tornado
Q133860300.blurb: A deadly tornado strikes Birmingham, England, damaging 2,221 homes and businesses.

Q133896506.name: 1957 Pacific Ocean Boeing C-97 disappearance
Q133896506.blurb: A United States Air Force aircraft disappears with all 67 people on board somewhere over the Pacific Ocean.

Q133980714.name: Foyot bombing
Q133980714.blurb: Foyot bombing by the Russian or French state during the Ère des attentats.

Q133999044.name: 2025 conclave
Q133999044.blurb: The 2025 papal conclave elects Cardinal Robert Francis Prevost, taking the name Leo XIV as the 267th Pope of the Catholic Church.

Q134044277.name: 2025 Pahalgam attack
Q134044277.blurb: At least 26 people are killed in a terrorist attack on a group of tourists in Pahalgam, Jammu and Kashmir. The Resistance Front (TRF), an offshoot of the Pakistan-based militant group Lashkar-e-Taiba claimed responsibility for the attack.

Q134119927.name: Nantes school stabbing
Q134119927.blurb: A mass stabbing at a school in Nantes, France, leaves one person dead and three others wounded.

Q134165503.name: 2025 Vancouver car attack
Q134165503.blurb: A car ramming attack at a Lapu-Lapu Day festival kills 11 people and injures at least 30 in Vancouver, Canada.

Q134179492.name: Assassination of George Lincoln Rockwell
Q134179492.blurb: George Lincoln Rockwell, founder of the American Nazi Party, is assassinated by a former member of his group.

Q134379167.name: 2025 India–Pakistan conflict
aliases: 2025-2026 Pakistani airspace closure for Indian airlines
2025–2026 Pakistani airspace closure for Indian airlines
Air engagements of the 2025 India-Pakistan standoff
Air engagements of the 2025 India–Pakistan standoff
International reactions to the 2025 India-Pakistan conflict
Q134379167.blurb: The Indian Army and the Indian Air Force conduct surgical strikes code-named Operation SINDOOR on terrorist hideouts in Pakistan in response to the Pahalgam Attack that killed 26 people.

Q134437783.name: Raid on Teignmouth
Q134437783.blurb: Nine Years' War: French naval forces led by Anne Hilarion de Tourville, fresh from their victory at Beachy Head, sail West and launch a raid on the small English town of Teignmouth, leaving it devastated.

Q134522739.name: Rouen Riot
Q134522739.blurb: The Rouen Riot, an attempt by English king William Rufus to take possession of Rouen, the capital city of his brother Robert, duke of Normandy, fails.

Q134582631.name: 2025 Liverpool parade incident
Q134582631.blurb: 65 people are injured when a car rams into a crowd on Water Street, near Liverpool F.C.'s Premier League trophy parade.

Q134622177.name: 2025 St. Louis tornado
Q134622177.blurb: A catastrophic EF3 tornado kills five people and causes over $1 billion in damages in St. Louis, MO.

Q134698175.name: 2025 Mongolian protests
Q134698175.blurb: Prime minister of Mongolia Luvsannamsrain Oyun-Erdene resigned after weeks of protests.

Q134710921.name: 2025 Bengaluru crowd crush
Q134710921.blurb: A crowd crush outside M. Chinnaswamy Stadium during celebrations of Royal Challengers Bengaluru's Indian Premier League title killed 11 people and injured 56 others.

Q134821352.name: 2025 Graz school shooting
Q134821352.blurb: Eleven people are killed, including the perpetrator, and eleven others are injured, in a mass shooting at a secondary school in Graz, Austria.

Q134880537.name: Air India Flight 171
Q134880537.blurb: Air India Flight 171, a Boeing 787-8 Dreamliner, crashes shortly after takeoff into the B. J. Medical College, Ahmedabad, India, killing 241 out of 242 onboard as well as 19 on the ground. This marked the first fatal crash and hull loss of the Boeing 787 Dreamliner.

Q134890295.name: Ghaznavid campaign in Khorasan
Q134890295.blurb: Rebel Turkish warlord Mahmud of Ghazni defeats Samanid Emir Mansur II in battle at Merv.

Q134978587.name: 1525 Bayham Abbey riot
Q134978587.blurb: Bayham Abbey riot: Villagers from Kent and Sussex, England riot and occupy Bayham Old Abbey for a week in protest against Cardinal Thomas Wolsey's order to suppress the monastery in order to fund two colleges founded by him.

Q135005864.name: 2025 United States strikes on Iranian nuclear sites
aliases: American strikes on Iranian nuclear sites

Q135010500.name: 2025 Santa Catarina hot air balloon crash
Q135010500.blurb: A hot air balloon catches fire mid-flight and crashes in Praia Grande, Santa Catarina, Brazil, killing 8 of the 21 on board.

Q135176887.name: Edwardsville Amazon warehouse collapse
Q135176887.blurb: A tornado strikes an Amazon warehouse during increased holiday demand, killing six sheltering workers.

Q135178904.name: Idler disaster
Q135178904.blurb: The luxury racing yacht Idler capsizes and sinks on Lake Erie during a storm, drowning six of its seven passengers (all members of the family of Cleveland businessman James C. Corrigan).

Q135218122.name: July 2025 Central Texas floods
aliases: Select Committees on Disaster Preparedness and Flooding
Q135218122.blurb: A devastating flood strikes the Texas Hill Country, killing at least 108 people.

Q135225059.name: Attempted assassination of Franklin D. Roosevelt
Q135225059.blurb: In Miami, Giuseppe Zangara attempts to assassinate US President-elect Franklin D. Roosevelt, but instead shoots Chicago mayor Anton J. Cermak, who dies of his wounds on March 6.

Q135234514.name: 1942 Phoenix Thanksgiving Day riot
Q135234514.blurb: A riot involving infantrymen, military police, and local law enforcement officers occurs in Phoenix, Arizona, United States, leading to three deaths.

Q135246079.name: 2015 Belgrade helicopter crash
Q135246079.blurb: Serbian Army Mi-17 helicopter crashes near Belgrade airport while transporting a 5-day-old baby with respiratory problems to hospital, killing all 7 on board.

Q135403858.name: 1975 Jubilee ordination
Q135403858.blurb: Pope Paul VI ordains some 350 priests in St. Peter's Square in the largest ordination in history

Q135433157.name: 2025 Dhaka fighter jet crash
Q135433157.blurb: A Bangladesh Air Force Chengdu FT-7BGI crashes shortly after takeoff into Milestone School campus in Dhaka, Bangladesh, killing 35 people and injuring 173.

Q135448873.name: Trial for the 2022–2023 coup plot in Brazil
Q135448873.blurb: Former Brazilian president Jair Bolsonaro was sentenced to 27 years in prison for his involvement in a coup plot.

Q135450625.name: Angara Airlines Flight 2311
Q135450625.blurb: Angara Airlines Flight 2311 crashes on approach to Tynda Airport, killing all 48 people on board.

Q135502884.name: 2025 Kamchatka earthquake
Q135502884.blurb: A magnitude 8.8 earthquake hits Russia, causing tsunamis over the Pacific Ocean.

Q135677419.name: 2025 Russia–United States summit
Q135677419.blurb: US president Donald Trump meets with Russian president Vladimir Putin in Alaska, the first such summit since the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

Q135797868.name: Floyd Patterson vs. Ingemar Johansson
Q135797868.blurb: Swedish boxer Ingemar Johansson becomes world champion of heavyweight boxing, by defeating American Floyd Patterson on technical knockout after two minutes and three seconds in the third round at Yankee Stadium.

Q136009028.name: Assassination of Andriy Parubiy

Q136418314.name: 2025 Manchester synagogue attack
Q136418314.blurb: 2 people are killed and at least 4 others injured in an attack on a synagogue in Manchester, UK, during Yom Kippur.

Q136449851.name: 2025 Enderlin tornado
Q136449851.blurb: The first EF5 tornado in 12 years occurs in Enderlin, North Dakota.

Q136466328.name: Demonstration of 9 March 1883
Q136466328.blurb: Demonstration of 9 March 1883:  Parisian anarchists, unemployed and carpenters narrowly miss the Presidential palace during a violent protest; first use of the black flag as a symbol of anarchism by Louise Michel.

Q136487699.name: 2025 Malagasy coup d'état
Q136487699.blurb: A coup d'état successfully overthrows Malagasy president Andry Rajoelina.

Q136513871.name: 2025 Alberta teachers' strike
Q136513871.blurb: The 2025 Alberta teachers' strike begins, leaving approximately 51,000 teachers off-work, impacting about 730,000 Albertan students.

Q136526023.name: Montceau-les-Mines troubles
Q136526023.blurb: Start of the second part of the Montceau-les-Mines troubles by the Black Band, groups of anarchist miners.

Q136536203.name: 2025 Louvre robbery
Q136536203.blurb: Pieces of the French Crown Jewels are successfully stolen during a heist on the Louvre Museum in Paris..

Q136540429.name: Règlement Organique
Q136540429.blurb: The Beyoglu Protocol turns the district of Mount Lebanon into an autonomous region within the Ottoman Empire and grants the Christians more power over the Druze.

Q136548986.name: Hurricane Melissa
Q136548986.blurb: Hurricane Melissa makes landfall near Black River, Jamaica, killing over 30 people, as well as tying the 1935 Labor Day hurricane as the most intense landfall in the North Atlantic.

Q136556880.name: 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine
Q136556880.blurb: Russian invasion of Ukraine: The Russian warship Moskva is struck by two anti-ship missiles and sinks into the Black Sea.

Q136705120.name: UPS Airlines Flight 2976
Q136705120.blurb: UPS Airlines Flight 2976, a McDonnell Douglas MD-11F crashes into multiple buildings during takeoff at Louisville Muhammad Ali International Airport in Louisville, Kentucky, killing 15 people, including the 3 crew members.

Q136723606.name: The First Salute
Q136723606.blurb: American Revolutionary War: A Dutch fort on Sint Eustatius fired The First Salute to an American brig (pictured), marking the first international recognition of the American flag.

Q136955662.name: 1885 Pierce City lynching
Q136955662.blurb: Five Chinese people were lynched outside of Pierce City in the Idaho Territory of the United States.

Q137017220.name: Wang Fuk Court fire
aliases: 2025 Hong Kong Hung Fook Court fire
Q137017220.blurb: The Wang Fuk Court fire, a catastrophic fire in Tai Po, Hong Kong, leaves at least 168 dead and 79 injured.

Q137213500.name: killing of Yasser Abu Shabab
Q137213500.blurb: Yasser Abu Shabab is assassinated near Rafah, Gaza Strip.

Q137266485.name: 2025 Beninese coup attempt
Q137266485.blurb: An attempted coup takes place in Benin, but is thwarted, and order restored.

Q137383251.name: 2025 Bondi Beach shooting
aliases: Aftermath of the 2025 Bondi Beach shooting
Timeline of the 2025 Bondi Beach shooting
Q137383251.blurb: At least 16 people are killed, including one gunman, and 43 injured in a mass shooting during a Hanukkah celebration at Bondi Beach in the deadliest terror incident in Australia.

Q137438772.name: killing of Rob Reiner and Michele Singer Reiner
aliases: Killing of Rob and Michele Reiner
Q137438772.blurb: Filmmakers Rob Reiner and Michele Singer Reiner are stabbed to death in their Brentwood, Los Angeles residence.

Q137560457.name: Harmony Jets Flight 185
Q137560457.blurb: The crash of Harmony Jets Flight 185 killed all eight people on board, including the Libyan Army chief Mohammed al-Haddad in Ankara, Turkey.

Q137612545.name: 2025–2026 Iranian protests

The revolution of the lion and the sun
Q137612545.blurb: Unrest in the form of mass protests erupt across Iran, the largest uprising in the country since the Iranian Revolution.

Q137652531.name: 2026 Crans-Montana bar fire

Q137703855.name: Raid on Santiago de Cuba
Q137703855.blurb: An English Buccaneer force led by Royal Navy commodore Christopher Myngs launches an attack on Santiago de Cuba which is subsequently sacked.

Q137734875.name: Assommoir bombing

Q137781638.name: 2026 Sikhio train disaster
Q137781638.blurb: Thirty-two people are killed when a crane falls onto a passenger train in Sikhio district, Thailand.

Q137801147.name: 2026 Indonesia Air Transport ATR 42 crash
Q137801147.blurb: Indonesia Air Transport ATR 42 crashed near Mount Bulusaraung in South Sulawesi, after losing contact en route to Makassar.

Q137809571.name: 2026 Adamuz train derailments
Q137809571.blurb: At least 45 people are killed and 292 others injured after two trains collide in Adamuz in the worst railway disaster in over a decade in Spain.

Q137884304.name: Mother's Day bus crash
Q137884304.blurb: Mother's Day bus crash kills 22 passengers and injures another 22, including the driver in New Orleans, Louisiana, United States.

Q137900439.name: 2026 West Bandung landslide
Q137900439.blurb: At least 70 people are killed and 10 others missing after major landslides in West Java, Indonesia.

Q137920366.name: 2026 Baramati Learjet 45 crash
Q137920366.blurb: A Learjet 45 crashes on approach to Baramati Airport in Maharashtra, killing all six occupants including the Deputy Chief Minister of Maharashtra, Ajit Pawar.

Q137940233.name: Hödel assassination attempt
Q137940233.blurb: Hödel assassination attempt by anarchist Max Hödel targeting the German Kaiser, Wilhelm I.

Q137945148.name: Nobiling assassination attempt
Q137945148.blurb: Nobiling assassination attempt by anarchist Karl Nobiling targeting the German Kaiser, Wilhelm I.

Q137988575.name: 2026 Rubaya mines collapses
Q137988575.blurb: The Rubaya mine collapse at Rubaya mines in DR Congo causes at least 400 deaths and injured several others.

Q138002938.name: Storm Kristin
Q138002938.blurb: Storm Kristin causes a catastrophic impact in Portugal and Spain with €6 billion in damage in the central region of Portugal, 15 deaths and 2,000 injuries.

Q138131899.name: 2026 Tumbler Ridge shootings
Q138131899.blurb: Shootings at a residence and a school in Tumbler Ridge, British Columbia, Canada, leave nine people dead and 27 injured.

Q138414208.name: 2026 Afghanistan–Pakistan War
Q138414208.blurb: The government of Pakistan declares "open war" against the Taliban in Afghanistan, initiating the 2026 Afghanistan–Pakistan War.

Q138492180.name: 2026 Cuban boat incident

Q138766846.name: Air Canada Express Flight 8646
aliases: March 2026 aviation incident at New York City's LaGuardia Airport
Q138766846.blurb: Air Canada Express Flight 8646, a Bombardier CRJ-900 operated by Jazz Aviation, collided with a fire truck while landing at LaGuardia Airport in New York City. Two fatalities were reported, both being the captain and the co-pilot. This marked the first fatal accident involving a CRJ-900.

Q138773815.name: 2026 Colombian Air Force Lockheed C-130 crash
Q138773815.blurb: An Aerospace Force Lockheed C-130 crashes during take-off in Puerto Leguízamo, Colombia, killing 69 people.

Q138798835.name: Bam Adebayo's 83-point game
aliases: Washington Wizards at Miami Heat, 10 March 2026
Q138798835.blurb: Bam Adebayo of the Miami Heat recorded the second-highest scoring game in NBA history with 83 Points.

Q138955465.name: 2026 Iran war ceasefire

Q139042111.name: 8 April 2026 Israeli attacks on Lebanon
Q139042111.blurb: Operation Eternal Darkness: Hours after a ceasefire to the Iran war, Israeli attacks on Lebanon kill at least 357 and injures more than 1200 people in the largest airstrikes of the Lebanon war.

Q139329722.name: Toronto circus riot
Q139329722.blurb: Firefighters in Toronto, Canada, destroyed the infrastructure of a visiting circus; police refusal to identify rioters caused widespread protest and a complete redesign of the city's police service.

Q139373327.name: 2026 Onikişubat school shooting
Q139373327.blurb: Twelve people and the perpetrator are killed and twelve others injured in a mass shooting at a school in Onikişubat, Turkey.

Q139415676.name: 2026 Kyiv shooting
Q139415676.blurb: Seven people are killed and fourteen others are injured in a mass shooting in Kyiv, Ukraine

Q139556342.name: 2026 Mali offensives
Q139556342.blurb: Malian minister of defence Sadio Camara is killed during the start of coordinated attacks in the country.

Q139559795.name: 2026 White House Correspondents' Dinner shooting
aliases: White House Correspondents' Dinner shooting in 2026
Q139559795.blurb: Shots are fired outside of the White House Correspondents' Dinner in the Washington Hilton where U.S. President Donald Trump and members of his cabinet are attending. One injury is reported and a suspect is taken into custody.

Q139571113.name: Killing of Sadio Camara
Q139571113.blurb: Malian minister of defence Sadio Camara is killed during the start of coordinated attacks in the country.

Q139572909.name: 2026 Argo Bromo Anggrek and Commuter Line train collision
Q139572909.blurb: A train crash  kills at least 15 people and injures 84 others near Jakarta, Indonesia.

Q139713361.name: 2026 Canvas security incident
Q139713361.blurb: After a ransomware attack by the group ShinyHunters, the education platform Canvas operated by private company Instructure, goes offline, affecting thousands of educational institutions.

Q139844425.name: 2026 Islamic Center of San Diego shooting
aliases: Islamic Center of San Diego shooting
Q139844425.blurb: A shooting carried out by two gunmen at the Islamic Center of San Diego results in the deaths of five people, including the perpetrators.

Q139898129.name: 2026 Liushenyu coal mine explosion
Q139898129.blurb: A gas explosion at a coal mine in Changzhi, Shanxi, leaves at least 82 people dead.

Q139915929.name: 2026 Quetta train bombing
Q139915929.blurb: A suicide bombing targeting a shuttle train in Quetta, Balochistan, killed at least 48 people and injured 98 others.

Q139994628.name: Killing of Peter Fechter
Q139994628.blurb: Peter Fechter is shot and bleeds to death while trying to cross the new Berlin Wall.

Q139994717.name: Killing of Jean Charles de Menezes
Q139994717.blurb: Jean Charles de Menezes is killed by police as the hunt begins for the London Bombers responsible for the 7 July 2005 London bombings and the 21 July 2005 London bombings.

Q139997516.name: 2026 Namhkam Township explosion
Q139997516.blurb: An explosion at a Ta'ang National Liberation Army base kills 46 people.

Q140202632.name: 2026 Rio de Janeiro mid-air collision
Q140202632.blurb: Two helicopters collide mid-air in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, killing all 6 people on board, including American singer-songwriter Oliver Tree, Argentine YouTuber Gaspi, director and screenwriter Lucas A. Vignale, and Brazilian music producer Lucas Frota.

Q140352499.name: 2026 Venezuela earthquakes
Q140352499.blurb: Two earthquakes strike Venezuela, leaving more than 2,200 people dead and dozens of others missing.

Q140528302.name: 2026 Bangkok pub fire
Q140528302.blurb: A bar fire kills 33 people in Bangkok, Thailand.

Q140774656.name: 2026 Morocco–Spain border incident
Q140774656.blurb: Around 50,000 Moroccan nationals storm the borders of Spanish enclaves in Africa, principally the city of Ceuta. As of August 1, 2026, 67 are confirmed to have died while crossing.

Q140800370.name: 2026 Broad Peak avalanche
Q140800370.blurb: An avalanche on Broad Peak in Pakistan kills 10 climbers.
